title: How long is a day on each planet?
prompt: Place each planet by NASA's listed day length.

items.label: Jupiter
items.fact: Jupiter takes about 10 hours to complete one rotation.

items.label: Neptune
items.fact: NASA lists Neptune's day at 16 hours.

items.label: Earth
items.fact: NASA lists Earth's day at 24 hours; a sidereal rotation is just under 23 hours 56 minutes.

items.label: Mercury
items.fact: Mercury's listed day lasts 1,408 hours, vastly longer than Earth's.

items.label: Venus
items.fact: Venus has the longest listed planetary day here at 5,832 hours.
